new_run_identity.reason: CP01R3 changes the seed construction and the nonlinear trust metric, so immutable-run governance requires a new run identity.

boundary_projection.purpose: Construct a deterministic initialization on the exact R_4D=R_chi=0 junction submanifold without changing the physical parameter point or brane field values.
boundary_projection.scope_firewall: BJP-01 is an initialization transform only. It is not a solved background and may increase bulk residuals.

new_seed_family.construction: Apply BJP-01 independently to each of the seven frozen CP01R2 seed multipliers at each frozen mesh.

trust_metric.principle: Trust clipping must not use the Jacobian-equilibrated z norm as the state-space distance.
trust_metric.field_block_metric: For each of the eight N-node field blocks, use RMS(delta_x_block / s_block), so changing node count alone does not grow the trust norm by sqrt(N).
trust_metric.parameter_metric: For each of eight global parameters use abs(delta_p)/s_p with s_p=max(1,abs(seed_p)) frozen at stage initialization

trust_update.design_basis: A dimensionless O(1) block-normalized state metric; values are protocol design constants and require manufactured-control validation before any physical release review.

progress_continuation.reason: D11 intentionally changes only initialization and trust geometry so the next experiment remains diagnostically attributable.

manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.name: exact_boundary_projection_algebra
manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.requirement: For diverse finite synthetic junction tuples with positive rho_N,rho_S,ell_sigma, BJP-01 must zero R_4D and R_chi to arithmetic tolerance while preserving Y_sigma and brane field values.

manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.name: pole_and_patch_invariant_control
manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.requirement: The derivative-only basis must preserve pole A values, Lhat(0)=1, brane A/ell matching values, and all six nonprojected boundary residuals.

manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.name: mesh_normalized_metric_control
manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.requirement: Sampling the same smooth perturbation at N=24,32,48,64,96 must give the same state-metric norm within registered discretization tolerance.

manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.name: linear_preconditioner_trust_decoupling_control
manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.requirement: Changing Jacobian column equilibration while preserving the recovered original-variable Newton direction must not change the state-metric trust norm or clip decision.

manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.name: synthetic_stiff_boundary_bulk_problem
manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.requirement: ETRN-02 must converge or fail closed on a manufactured coupled boundary/bulk problem with known root and must export rho, state-metric step norm and trust history.

manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.name: nonfinite_and_admissibility_firewall
manufactured_control_suite_required_befo.requirement: Nonfinite states, invalid radii and inadmissible trial states must be rejected without state mutation.
